1: // Simple Canvas Escape game based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas element with id="game" expected in HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width;
8:   const height = canvas.height;
9: 
10:   // Game state
11:   const player = { x: 20, y: 20, size: 20, speed: 2 };
12:   const barriers = [];
13:   const tokens = [];
14:   let lastTokenTime = 0;
15:   let score = 0;
16:   let gameOver = false;
17:   const keys = {};
18: 
19:   // Utility
20:   const rectIntersect = (a, b) =>
21:     a.x < b.x + b.size && a.x + a.size > b.x &&
22:     a.y < b.y + b.size && a.y + a.size > b.y;
23: 
24:   // Input handling
25:   // Initialize AudioContext for sound effects
26:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
27:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
28:   let audioStarted = false;
29:   const ensureAudio = () => {
30:     if (!audioStarted) {
31:       audioCtx.resume();
32:       audioStarted = true;
33:     }
34:   };
35:   const playTone = (freq, duration = 0.1) => {
36:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
37:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
38:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
39:     osc.type = 'sine';
40:     osc.connect(gain);
41:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
42:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
43:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
44:     osc.start();
45:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
46:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
47:   };
48:   const playTokenSound = () => playTone(800, 0.15);
49:   const playCollisionSound = () => playTone(200, 0.3);
50: 
51:   // Input handling
52:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; ensureAudio(); });
53:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
54:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
55:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
56: 
57:   // Create moving barriers (simple back‑and‑forth)
58:   const createBarriers = () => {
59:     for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
60:       const horiz = i % 2 === 0; // alternating orientation
61:       const barrier = {
62:         x: horiz ? Math.random() * (width - 100) : Math.random() * width,
63:         y: horiz ? Math.random() * height : Math.random() * (height - 100),
64:         w: horiz ? 100 : 20,
65:         h: horiz ? 20 : 100,
66:         dx: horiz ? (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * 1 : 0,
67:         dy: horiz ? 0 : (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * 1,
68:         size: 0 // unused; keep API same as player/token
69:       };
70:       barriers.push(barrier);
71:     }
72:   };
73: 
74:   // Spawn a token at a random location
75:   const spawnToken = () => {
76:     const token = {
77:       x: Math.random() * (width - 20),
78:       y: Math.random() * (height - 20),
79:       size: 20,
80:       glow: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5 // for visual effect
81:     };
82:     tokens.push(token);
83:   };
84: 
85:   // Update loop
86:   const update = dt => {
87:     if (gameOver) return;
88:     // Move player
89:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) player.y -= player.speed;
90:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) player.y += player.speed;
91:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) player.x -= player.speed;
92:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) player.x += player.speed;
93:     // Clamp
94:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - player.size, player.x));
95:     player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - player.size, player.y));
96: 
97:     // Move barriers
98:     barriers.forEach(b => {
99:       b.x += b.dx;
100:       b.y += b.dy;
101:       if (b.x < 0 || b.x + b.w > width) b.dx *= -1;
102:       if (b.y < 0 || b.y + b.h > height) b.dy *= -1;
103:     });
104: 
105:     // Collision detection player vs barriers
106:     for (const b of barriers) {
107:       const rect = { x: b.x, y: b.y, size: 0, w: b.w, h: b.h };
108:       // simple AABB check
109:       if (
110:         player.x < b.x + b.w && player.x + player.size > b.x &&
111:         player.y < b.y + b.h && player.y + player.size > b.y
112:       ) {
113:         playCollisionSound();
114:           gameOver = true;
115:       }
116:     }
117: 
118:     // Token collection
119:     for (let i = tokens.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
120: if (rectIntersect(player, tokens[i])) {
121:           tokens.splice(i, 1);
122:           score++;
123:           playTokenSound();
124:         }
125:     }
126: 
127:     // Spawn token every 3 seconds
128:     if (Date.now() - lastTokenTime > 3000) {
129:       spawnToken();
130:       lastTokenTime = Date.now();
131:     }
132:   };
133: 
134:   // Render loop with enhanced graphics
135:   // Helper to draw rounded rectangle
136:   const drawRoundedRect = (x, y, w, h, radius, fillStyle) => {
137:     ctx.save();
138:     ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle;
139:     ctx.beginPath();
140:     ctx.moveTo(x + radius, y);
141:     ctx.lineTo(x + w - radius, y);
142:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + radius);
143:     ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - radius);
144:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - radius, y + h);
145:     ctx.lineTo(x + radius, y + h);
146:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - radius);
147:     ctx.lineTo(x, y + radius);
148:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + radius, y);
149:     ctx.closePath();
150:     ctx.fill();
151:     ctx.restore();
152:   };
153: 
154:   // Helper to draw glowing token
155:   const drawToken = (token) => {
156:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
157:       token.x + token.size / 2,
158:       token.y + token.size / 2,
159:       token.size * 0.2,
160:       token.x + token.size / 2,
161:       token.y + token.size / 2,
162:       token.size / 2
163:     );
164:     grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,215,0,${Math.min(token.glow + 0.3, 1)})`);
165:     grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,215,0,0)');
166:     ctx.save();
167:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
168:     ctx.beginPath();
169:     ctx.arc(token.x + token.size / 2, token.y + token.size / 2, token.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
170:     ctx.fill();
171:     ctx.restore();
172:   };
173: 
174:   const render = () => {
175:     // Background
176:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
177:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
178:     // Player with gradient rounded rect
179:     const playerGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, player.size, player.size);
180:     playerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4a90e2');
181:     playerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#007aff');
182:     drawRoundedRect(player.x, player.y, player.size, player.size, 4, playerGrad);
183:     // Barriers with red gradient
184:     const barrierGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 20);
185:     barrierGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ff4d4d');
186:     barrierGrad.addColorStop(1, '#b20000');
187:     barriers.forEach(b => drawRoundedRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 3, barrierGrad));
188:     // Tokens
189:     tokens.forEach(t => drawToken(t));
190:     // UI
191:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
192:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
193:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
194:     if (gameOver) {
195:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
196:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
197:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
198:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
199:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
200:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
201:     }
202:   };
203:   const render = () => {
204:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
205:     // Player
206:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00f';
207:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.size, player.size);
208:     // Barriers
209:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
210:     barriers.forEach(b => ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h));
211:     // Tokens
212:     tokens.forEach(t => {
213:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,215,0,${t.glow})`;
214:       ctx.fillRect(t.x, t.y, t.size, t.size);
215:     });
216:     // UI
217:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
218:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
219:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
220:     if (gameOver) {
221:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
222:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
223:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
224:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
225:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
226:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
227:     }
228:   };
229: 
230:   // Main loop using requestAnimationFrame
231:   let last = performance.now();
232:   const loop = now => {
233:     const dt = now - last;
234:     last = now;
235:     update(dt);
236:     render();
237:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
238:   };
239: 
240:   createBarriers();
241:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
242: })();
